name: Decal_Burn_Floor_Hole_01
class: decal (alpha decal texture set; no mesh)

textures.channels: base colour sRGB + opacity in alpha
tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic (0)

material_exception: decal set private to this decal; a deferred decal cannot use the tiling library sets of ART_STANDARD.md section 2
source_note: the source is the height field generated by the build script (seeded, deterministic); the .blend holds the review scene with the decal blended over the ground
origin_ids_note: the family shares its origin IDs between all of its frames; this decal dresses the placements that show frame 158/4
dresses: large burnt-through hole in a floor or roof, about 2 m across: a ragged char edge, three charred joists crossing the dark opening, a scorched band round it
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound in families.json
known_weaknesses: A flat decal: the burnt-through opening is black with joists painted across it and a normal-map lip, with no real depth or parallax, so it reads as painted from a low camera; a real hole needs the floor mesh cut. The ember glow is a static emissive map (no flicker, no light cast, no flames: those are effects). Soot opacity assumes a mid-toned floor. Unreal decal material is not built here.
